keys.name: api.cors_allowed_origins
keys.doc: Additional origins that get CORS headers; each entry is an origin such as https://app.example.com.

keys.name: audit.deny_aggregate_max_keys
keys.doc: Most open aggregations of denials per process; a new key beyond it writes the oldest at once.

keys.name: audit.deny_aggregate_window
keys.doc: Window from the first of identical denials within which they become one audit entry with a count.

keys.name: auth.step_up_max_age
keys.doc: How long a step-up confirmation counts as fresh for actions that need one.

keys.name: authz.snapshot_cache_max_entries
keys.doc: Most rights snapshots a process keeps in memory (least recently used go first).

keys.name: database.acquire_timeout
keys.doc: How long a request waits for a pool connection before it gets 503 unavailable.

keys.name: database.host
keys.doc: Host name or address of the database, or the directory of its Unix socket when it starts with a slash.

keys.name: database.idle_in_tx_timeout
keys.doc: How long an open transaction may sit without work before the database ends the session.

keys.name: database.listen_reconnect_backoff_cap
keys.doc: Longest pause between attempts to reconnect the LISTEN connection.

keys.name: database.lock_timeout
keys.doc: How long a statement waits for a lock.

keys.name: database.max_conns
keys.doc: Size of the connection pool of each process.

keys.name: database.name
keys.doc: Name of the database.

keys.name: database.password_ref
keys.doc: Secret reference of the password of database.user, read again for every new connection.

keys.name: database.port
keys.doc: Port of the database in the network of the server.

keys.name: database.sslmode
keys.doc: TLS to the database: verify-full, or disable only inside the internal Compose network (SEC-TLS-5).

keys.name: database.sslrootcert
keys.doc: PEM file with the CA certificates for verify-full; empty uses the system roots.

keys.name: database.statement_timeout
keys.doc: Deadline of a single SQL statement, overridable per transaction.

keys.name: database.tx_retry_max
keys.doc: Retries of a unit of work after a deadlock or a lock timeout.

keys.name: database.user
keys.doc: Database role of the process: bothy_app for api and worker, bothy_owner for bothy migrate.

keys.name: egress.allowed_hosts
keys.doc: Additional allowed targets of outgoing connections, each host[:port][;allow_private]; allow_private also opens private addresses and plain http.

keys.name: egress.max_response_bytes
keys.doc: Largest response body and header of one outgoing request in bytes; a larger body is an error.

keys.name: egress.timeout
keys.doc: Time limit of one outgoing request, from name resolution to the end of the body.

keys.name: file.max_upload_bytes
keys.doc: Largest file, and the stream limit of multipart and octet-stream request bodies.

keys.name: http.hsts_max_age
keys.doc: max-age of Strict-Transport-Security in whole seconds, sent while server.public_url uses https.

keys.name: http.idle_timeout
keys.doc: How long a keep-alive connection may stay idle before the server closes it.

keys.name: http.max_header_bytes
keys.doc: Largest request header block in bytes.

keys.name: http.max_json_body_bytes
keys.doc: Largest JSON request body in bytes; it must be greater than message.max_content_bytes.

keys.name: http.max_json_depth
keys.doc: Deepest nesting of a JSON request body; deeper bodies are refused with 400 malformed_request.

keys.name: http.read_header_timeout
keys.doc: Time a client has to send the request headers.

keys.name: http.request_timeout
keys.doc: Context deadline of a normal request.

keys.name: http.transfer_timeout
keys.doc: Deadline of upload and download operations, applied to the connection.

keys.name: http.unavailable_retry_after
keys.doc: Retry-After of every 503 unavailable response, in whole seconds.

keys.name: instance.environment
keys.doc: Environment of the instance: dev, staging or prod.

keys.name: jobs.queue.default.max_workers
keys.doc: Parallel workers of the queue default for short domain jobs.

keys.name: jobs.queue.delivery.max_workers
keys.doc: Parallel workers of the queue delivery for push and webhooks.

keys.name: jobs.queue.files.max_workers
keys.doc: Parallel workers of the queue files for scans, thumbnails and transcription.

keys.name: jobs.queue.maintenance.max_workers
keys.doc: Parallel workers of the queue maintenance for cleanup, partitions and checks.

keys.name: jobs.queue.privacy.max_workers
keys.doc: Parallel workers of the queue privacy for export and erasure.

keys.name: jobs.schema
keys.doc: PostgreSQL schema of River's job tables, separate from the domain tables.

keys.name: message.max_content_bytes
keys.doc: Largest content of one message in bytes.

keys.name: migrate.app_password_ref
keys.doc: Secret reference of the password bothy migrate up --bootstrap sets for bothy_app.

keys.name: migrate.bootstrap_password_ref
keys.doc: Secret reference of the password of migrate.bootstrap_user.

keys.name: migrate.bootstrap_user
keys.doc: Superuser login used only by bothy migrate up --bootstrap.

keys.name: migrate.lock_timeout
keys.doc: lock_timeout of every migration step, so a step that waits for a lock fails instead of blocking the application.

keys.name: migrate.maint_password_ref
keys.doc: Secret reference of the password bothy migrate up --bootstrap sets for bothy_maint.

keys.name: migrate.monitor_password_ref
keys.doc: Secret reference of the password bothy migrate up --bootstrap sets for bothy_monitor.

keys.name: migrate.owner_password_ref
keys.doc: Secret reference of the password bothy migrate up --bootstrap sets for bothy_owner.

keys.name: principal.display_name_max_chars
keys.doc: Longest display name of a principal in Unicode characters.

keys.name: principal.handle_max_chars
keys.doc: Longest handle of a principal in characters.

keys.name: privacy.audit_ip_kek_ref
keys.doc: Secret reference of the key that encrypts the keys of the IP pseudonyms in the database; 32 bytes as hex.

keys.name: privacy.audit_ip_key_period
keys.doc: Length of the period of one key of the IP pseudonyms in the audit log.

keys.name: privacy.audit_ip_key_retention
keys.doc: How long after its period a key of the IP pseudonyms is kept before it is destroyed.

keys.name: privacy.telemetry_pseudonym_rotation
keys.doc: Length of one period of the telemetry pseudonyms; each period derives its own key.

keys.name: ratelimit.max_tracked_keys
keys.doc: Most rate-limit buckets one process holds; beyond it full, then least recently used buckets are removed.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.admin.burst
keys.doc: Capacity of the bucket of rl.admin: requests a key may send at once.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.admin.per_minute
keys.doc: Tokens per minute that the bucket of rl.admin refills, per key of the class.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.agent_runtime.burst
keys.doc: Capacity of the bucket of rl.agent_runtime: requests a key may send at once.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.agent_runtime.per_minute
keys.doc: Tokens per minute that the bucket of rl.agent_runtime refills, per key of the class.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.export.burst
keys.doc: Capacity of the bucket of rl.export: requests a key may send at once.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.export.per_minute
keys.doc: Tokens per minute that the bucket of rl.export refills, per key of the class.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.gateway_connect.burst
keys.doc: Capacity of the bucket of rl.gateway_connect: requests a key may send at once.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.gateway_connect.per_minute
keys.doc: Tokens per minute that the bucket of rl.gateway_connect refills, per key of the class.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.host.burst
keys.doc: Capacity of the bucket of rl.host: requests a key may send at once.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.host.per_minute
keys.doc: Tokens per minute that the bucket of rl.host refills, per key of the class.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.import.burst
keys.doc: Capacity of the bucket of rl.import: requests a key may send at once.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.import.per_minute
keys.doc: Tokens per minute that the bucket of rl.import refills, per key of the class.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.interaction.burst
keys.doc: Capacity of the bucket of rl.interaction: requests a key may send at once.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.interaction.per_minute
keys.doc: Tokens per minute that the bucket of rl.interaction refills, per key of the class.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.message.burst
keys.doc: Capacity of the bucket of rl.message: requests a key may send at once.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.message.per_minute
keys.doc: Tokens per minute that the bucket of rl.message refills, per key of the class.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.public_auth.burst
keys.doc: Capacity of the bucket of rl.public_auth: requests a key may send at once.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.public_auth.per_minute
keys.doc: Tokens per minute that the bucket of rl.public_auth refills, per key of the class.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.read.burst
keys.doc: Capacity of the bucket of rl.read: requests a key may send at once.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.read.per_minute
keys.doc: Tokens per minute that the bucket of rl.read refills, per key of the class.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.search.burst
keys.doc: Capacity of the bucket of rl.search: requests a key may send at once.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.search.per_minute
keys.doc: Tokens per minute that the bucket of rl.search refills, per key of the class.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.terminal.burst
keys.doc: Capacity of the bucket of rl.terminal: requests a key may send at once.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.terminal.per_minute
keys.doc: Tokens per minute that the bucket of rl.terminal refills, per key of the class.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.trigger.burst
keys.doc: Capacity of the bucket of rl.trigger: requests a key may send at once.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.trigger.per_minute
keys.doc: Tokens per minute that the bucket of rl.trigger refills, per key of the class.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.typing.burst
keys.doc: Capacity of the bucket of rl.typing: requests a key may send at once.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.typing.per_minute
keys.doc: Tokens per minute that the bucket of rl.typing refills, per key of the class.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.upload.burst
keys.doc: Capacity of the bucket of rl.upload: requests a key may send at once.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.upload.per_minute
keys.doc: Tokens per minute that the bucket of rl.upload refills, per key of the class.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.webhook_in.burst
keys.doc: Capacity of the bucket of rl.webhook_in: requests a key may send at once.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.webhook_in.per_minute
keys.doc: Tokens per minute that the bucket of rl.webhook_in refills, per key of the class.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.write.burst
keys.doc: Capacity of the bucket of rl.write: requests a key may send at once.

keys.name: ratelimit.rl.write.per_minute
keys.doc: Tokens per minute that the bucket of rl.write refills, per key of the class.

keys.name: ratelimit.sweep_interval
keys.doc: Interval in which full rate-limit buckets are removed; a full bucket decides like a missing one.

keys.name: secrets.cache_ttl
keys.doc: How long a secret that was read stays in use before it is read again.

keys.name: secrets.dir
keys.doc: Base directory of the default file: references of secrets.

keys.name: server.internal_listen_addr
keys.doc: Address of the internal listener for health, readiness and incoming webhooks from services in the stack.

keys.name: server.listen_addr
keys.doc: Address of the public listener that serves REST and the gateway.

keys.name: server.public_url
keys.doc: Origin under which apps reach the server; the base of the DPoP htu, token audience and WebAuthn.

keys.name: server.role
keys.doc: Role of the process: api serves REST and the gateway, worker runs jobs and consumers, all does both.

keys.name: server.tls_cert_ref
keys.doc: Reference to the PEM certificate chain, leaf first; empty means the server terminates no TLS.

keys.name: server.tls_key_ref
keys.doc: Reference to the PEM private key of the certificate; only together with server.tls_cert_ref.

keys.name: server.trusted_proxies
keys.doc: Peers whose forwarding and identity headers count and that may send plaintext.

keys.name: shutdown.drain_delay
keys.doc: Wait after readiness turns false, so the proxy stops sending new requests.

keys.name: shutdown.http_grace
keys.doc: Time running HTTP requests get to finish during the shutdown.

keys.name: shutdown.jobs_soft_timeout
keys.doc: Time running jobs get to finish during the shutdown before their contexts are cancelled.

keys.name: shutdown.telemetry_flush_timeout
keys.doc: Time the shutdown gives telemetry to export what it still holds.

keys.name: shutdown.total_timeout
keys.doc: Whole budget of the shutdown; at least the sum of the step budgets, and the orchestrator waits longer.

keys.name: startup.dependency_wait
keys.doc: How long the start and bothy migrate wait for the database before they give up.

keys.name: sync.event_log_partition_size
keys.doc: Sequence numbers per partition of event_log.

keys.name: sync.event_log_partitions_ahead
keys.doc: Partitions of event_log that stand ready above the head.

keys.name: sync.event_payload_max_bytes
keys.doc: The payload of an event must be smaller than this many bytes; larger objects get a reduced payload.

keys.name: sync.event_retention
keys.doc: How long durable events stay available for catch-up before their partition is detached.

keys.name: sync.log_poll_interval
keys.doc: How often the log tail reads event_log without a notification.

keys.name: sync.partition_maintenance_interval
keys.doc: Interval of the job sync.partition_maintenance.

keys.name: sync.tail_batch_size
keys.doc: Events per read of the log tail.

keys.name: telemetry.enabled
keys.doc: Turns the OTLP export of traces, metrics and logs on or off; logs then go to stdout.

keys.name: telemetry.logs.exporter
keys.doc: Where logs go: OTLP to the collector, JSON on stdout, or both.

keys.name: telemetry.logs.level
keys.doc: Lowest level that is written.

keys.name: telemetry.pseudonym_key_ref
keys.doc: Secret reference of the key for HMAC pseudonyms of people in telemetry; at least 32 bytes.

keys.name: telemetry.traces.sampler_ratio
keys.doc: Share of new traces the SDK records; the collector samples again after that.

keys.name: telemetry.traces.trust_remote_parent
keys.doc: With true an incoming traceparent becomes the parent of the server span, otherwise only a span link.
